name: Devil Apartment
source:
By the will of fate, Jake finds himself in an abandoned building, from which there is no way out, and becomes a participant in a deadly game. But he's not alone here. Teaming up with another player, he will have to complete tasks and move forward.

Why are they here? Who is behind all this? And will they be able to get out of here alive?

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2420890/]Steam[/url]]
translation:
命运使然，Jake来到一栋无法逃出的废弃建筑，被迫参加一场致命游戏。不过，他并非孤身一人。他必须与另一名玩家合作，完成任务，不断前进。

他们为什么会来到这里？这一切的幕后主使是谁？他们又能否活着逃出去？

[摘自[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2420890/]Steam[/url]]
